### 💡 Description of the Improvement
A clear and concise description of what you would like to see improved or added to ROImob.

### 🎯 Problem or Use Case
What problem does this feature solve? Who benefits from it (e.g., individual home owners, real estate agents, institutional investors, expats)?

### 🔬 Proposed Solution / Workflow
Describe how you envision the feature working:
1. User does X...
2. The calculator takes input Y...
3. The resulting metric/chart shows Z...

### 📊 Alternative Solutions or References
Have you seen this implemented elsewhere or do you have links/spreadsheets that illustrate the calculation?

### 🌐 Applicable Jurisdiction / Scope
- [ ] Romania-wide (ANAF / BNR)
- [ ] City-specific (Bucharest, Cluj, Timișoara, Iași, Brașov, Constanța, etc.)
- [ ] International / Multi-currency
- [ ] UI / UX / Mobile Responsiveness
- [ ] Translations / Localization (RO, EN, FR, DE, UK, PT)

### 📸 Additional Context or Mockups
Add any screenshots, diagrams, or context here.
